title: Luma Ray 3 Video Generation Prompt Schema
description: Schema for validating Luma Ray 3 (Dream Machine) video generation prompts produced by this skill.

prompt.description: Scene/action description following the 6-element formula: Camera/Shot + Subject + Action + Camera Movement + Lighting + Mood. For Enhanced mode: 1-2 sentences. For Unenhanced mode: 3-4 detailed sentences. Use @character tag for named characters requiring identity consistency.

resolution.description: Output resolution. 720p for faster iteration. 1080p for production quality. 4K available via built-in upscale feature post-generation.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame aspect ratio. 16:9 for widescreen/cinematic. 9:16 for vertical/mobile. 3:4 and 4:3 for standard formats.

duration.description: Clip duration in seconds. 5s for best quality and consistency. 10s for continuous motion sequences. Extensions up to 9s per segment via keyframes.

prompt_mode.description: 'enhanced' = AI auto-expands short prompts (best for 1-2 sentence concepts). 'unenhanced' = uses exact prompt with no AI modification (required for complex scenes, precise choreography, multi-stage events).

hdr.description: Enable native HDR generation. Produces studio-grade high dynamic range with 16-bit EXR export capability. Always ON for professional work intended for color grading.

loop.description: Create seamless loop animation. Useful for background elements, ambient scenes, or repeating motion cycles.

generation_mode.description: 'text-to-video' = from prompt only. 'image-to-video' = animate a start frame. 'keyframe' = transition between start and end frames. 'modify' = video-to-video editing with character reference.

start_frame_url.description: URL or path to start frame image. Required for image-to-video and keyframe modes. Optional for modify mode.

end_frame_url.description: URL or path to end frame image. Used in keyframe mode to define the destination visual state.

character_tag.description: The @character identifier used in the prompt for identity consistency (e.g., '@reva', '@mira'). Must match the tag used in the prompt text.

character_references.description: Character reference images for maintaining identity across generations. Upload 1-3 reference images. Works best with clear, front-facing views.

image_url.description: URL or path to character reference image.

character_name.description: Character name matching the @character tag (without the @ prefix).

reference_settings.description: Configuration for Reference mode in Dream Machine.

reference_mode.description: Type of reference being used. 'character' for people/creatures, 'vehicle' for cars/ships, 'background' for environments, 'style' for aesthetic.

reference_model.description: IMPORTANT: Must select 'image_v2' for character references. The UI defaults to 'photon' which is less effective for character consistency.

modify_settings.description: Settings for the Modify (video-to-video) feature. Only used when generation_mode is 'modify'.

input_video_url.description: URL or path to the input video to be modified.

modify_start_frame.description: Whether to modify the start frame of the input video.

modify_end_frame.description: Whether to modify the end frame of the input video.

frame_strength.description: How strictly to maintain the reference frame. 'flex_1' recommended for face consistency. 'strict' for minimal deviation.

character_reference_url.description: URL or path to character reference image for identity in modify mode. Referenced as 'image1' or 'cref' in the prompt.

camera.description: Structured camera movement data. Supplements the prompt text — camera movement should ALSO appear in natural language in the prompt.

secondary_movement.description: Optional secondary camera movement to combine with primary. Limit to 1 secondary for reliable results.

audio.description: Audio generation is a SEPARATE step in Ray 3 — not embedded in the video prompt. This object tracks audio intent for the post-generation audio step.

audio_prompt.description: The audio prompt to use in the separate audio generation step.

generate_audio.description: Whether audio should be generated as a follow-up step.

metadata.description: Pipeline tracking metadata. Not sent to Luma API — used for internal tracking.

skill_version.description: SKILL version that generated this prompt.

continuity_anchor.description: Whether this shot serves as a visual reference for continuity.

source_image_skill.description: If the start frame was generated by another SKILL, note which one (e.g., 'ideogram-v3', 'sd-3.5').
